description: $0.04 per call for one to 25 mints, not per mint. Use when a screener checks a list, some possibly outside the live window; from 21 mints up it costs less per mint than check_watchlist_risk ($0.01 for five). Input: mints (1-25 distinct, each a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link). Each covered mint gets the compact check's item plus its verdict word and market; a mint outside the live window is listed as unavailable instead of failing the batch. Charged when at least one mint is covered and feed lag <= 5 s; none covered, more than 25, a malformed or repeated mint is refused before payment. No flags observed is not a safety guarantee.
